description: This file contains utility functions related to inbound email handling in SuiteCRM, including options rendering, signature management, and view-specific logic for email interactions.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user entity with methods to access preferences and signatures.

methods.name: getInboundEmailDistributionOptions
methods.description: Returns HTML for setting inbound email distribution options based on the view context.

methods.name: getUserSignature
methods.description: Retrieves the user's email signature for inbound email, varying by view context.

methods.name: getInboundEmailSignatures
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element with user's email signatures.
